approved_numerical_corrections.acceptance_reason: The correction removes float32-derived constant precision loss and improves agreement with the NumPy float64 reference.

known_limitations: M and H are melanin-sensitive and hemoglobin-sensitive controls, not true physiological concentrations.
The forward model does not prove unique inversion of real phone JPEG images.
Three Point Grey Grasshopper 50S5C camera-light combinations remain unqualified.
Phone JPEG processing includes unknown ISP, white balance, HDR, tone mapping, sharpening, denoising, and compression.
